subject.title: refactor(extensions): remove orphaned shadow trial and retired config aliases

question: Should this maintainer-labeled cleanup land after an operator-facing upgrade proof confirms Doctor migration and canonical QQBot/Feishu runtime behavior?
rationale: The branch intentionally removes compatibility inputs from normal runtime paths; tests demonstrate migration transforms, but the remaining choice is whether the provided upgrade evidence is sufficient for existing operator configurations.

options.title: Require upgrade proof before landing
options.body: Run Doctor on representative root and account alias configurations, then show the canonical config and a post-migration Feishu/QQBot runtime check.

options.title: Accept unit-level migration evidence
options.body: Land based on the focused Doctor tests and accept that operators needing legacy aliases will use the documented Doctor recovery path.

recommendation.title: Require upgrade proof before landing
recommendation.body: Run Doctor on representative root and account alias configurations, then show the canonical config and a post-migration Feishu/QQBot runtime check.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch author implemented the migration boundary and can provide the narrow upgrade demonstration requested.
